Traits Signal

When an ally would spend Encore, they may instead declare the spend before the roll is made and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to that check rather than rerolling it after a failure. They must say so aloud before the die is rolled. This uses the same once-per-round allowance and the same 1 Encore cost as the normal spend, and because nothing is rerolled it is not a fortune effect.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB1 — this clause is interesting because it *substitutes* a `FlatModifier` for the SB2-blocked reroll, which in isolation would be real (a toggleable pre-roll bonus, per P7's shape) — but it is still entirely gated behind spending from the SB1-nonexistent Encore pool and the "once per round" shared-spend tracking, which has no vehicle either. Net: INCOMPLETE.
